page: UpCloud CLOUDNATIVE-2xCPU-8GB is a general-purpose virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an AMD EPYC 7542 processor. The configuration provides 2 vCPUs with shared CPU allocation, operating at a clock speed of 2.0 GHz. It includes 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage or GPU accelerators are bundled with this instance, though it includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results indicate modest performance characteristics, largely due to the shared CPU allocation. The instance scored in the bottom 10% for both single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU tests, as well as static web serving throughput and Redis SET operations. However, it achieved average performance in single-threaded gzip compression, single-threaded bzip3 decompression, and Geekbench single-core tests. Memory bandwidth tests for both cached and uncached reads and writes consistently fell into the bottom 25%.

This server offers a budget-friendly hardware profile for workloads that do not require dedicated CPU resources. The primary tradeoff is the shared CPU model, which limits sustained multi-threaded performance and makes it less suitable for intensive database operations or heavy compilation tasks. It is best suited for lightweight, non-critical workloads such as basic web serving, development environments, text processing, or small-scale background utilities.
